record.question: In traditional Mizo society 'sal' was
options: a person who surrendered himself to the Chief for his safety because of crime he committed.
a person who took refuge and seek shelter under the Chief's house due to poverty
a captive during wars or feuds.
a person who was sold to the Chief during his or her childhood to pacify the Chief.
